data.one_liner: Extended capabilities and shortcuts for Dart collections to reduce boilerplate work.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of extensions for Iterables in Dart, offering shortcuts for filtering, mapping, grouping, math calculations, and set operations. Helps avoid unnecessary boilerplate when working with lists and iterables.
use_when: You want to avoid repetitive boilerplate code when filtering and mapping collections
You need convenient utilities for getting null-safe first, last, or single elements
You need built-in math operations like sum and average on iterables
avoid_when: You prefer using standard Dart SDK collection methods exclusively
strengths: Reduces boilerplate code for common collection operations
Provides null-safe getters for first, last, and single elements
Supports grouping, math, and set operations out of the box
weaknesses: Adds external dependency for operations largely covered by standard libraries or package:collection
